summary:
Registered an OPEN owner-proposed two-clause power/actual-causation-to-concreteness commitment with independently supplied predicates, after fresh related/dossier reuse of STMT-NECESSARY-CONCRETE-CAUSAL-CAPACITY. Rejected the existing response-capacity criterion as an exact synonym: it defines the test criterion instead of independently constraining concreteness. Added no theorem, proof result, source attribution or self-evidence. The note distinguishes capacity/exercise, explicit abstract/concrete disjointness, immaterial agency, and cause/support/adequacy interfaces. Even assuming the owner premise, P2-B still needs existence of an appropriate actual existential supporter; support-to-cause/power and endpoint actuality are not supplied. No new countermodel or frontier closure. Shared convention sourceRevision625cb04ca568aebc8d45c90033e107a05e9bd2a0. Owner correction rejected the initial optional-only disjointness/dictionary approach: independent labels alone did not enforce intended causal semantics. Revised IntendedProfile REQUIRES disjointness, actual causal exercise evidencing thin power, and power-to-concrete. P2At/P3At consume this wrapper and the SAME old grounds relation. No arbitrary-predicate Cause-to-Power theorem, new proof certificate or change to generic Ontic/frozen Challenges. Thin power is weaker than full intervention-response/control analyses. Existing formal models do not satisfy the intended contract merely by naming their predicates. Further owner correction requires operative existing-model adaptation, not only wrapper aliases. Added powerExists and causalEndpoints interpretation guards (no inequality), and two checked constructors doubledExample/rigidExample retaining EXACT 1079 named underlying profiles. Thin capacity is actual existence plus independent root role, not concrete status or outgoing-edge definition. Abstract extension empty as in the all-concrete inventory; no mixed ontology/actual-world fit. General 1079 source schema may permit nonconcrete causers, so it is not claimed to meet this contract without extra evidence; old frozen theorem unchanged. Final focused revised-module build passes. Actual #print axioms probes on all nine definitions/constructors report no axioms; rfl checks confirm both underlying profiles literally equal old expressions, and existing doublesWellFounded certificates typecheck as P3At for both. These are compatibility/adaptation checks, not new argument certificates or independent metaphysical premise evidence. Focused premise-status compilecheck: doubledExample fails P2At at false by old population/WF/no-necessary theorems; rigidExample satisfies P2At only vacuously because every actual candidate exists at every world. Both satisfy P3At. Neither refutes the existing P2+P3 necessary-concrete implication. These findings are persisted in the linked note; no extra result certificate.

Definition/rival follow-up: four existing automatic rival edges concealed productive/no-esse/selected-world guards. Preserved all raw account/source identities and owner approval; reclassified the four broad edges as attacks and added the exact unrefuted selected-profile negative. Sixteen checked results register category/classification/world bridges, a weaker selected-set-causer input, structural commitment/countercase and named-coverage/remainder forks, exact conditional negation and positive named-case elimination to the SAME original target. Three anchored controls distinguish concrete productive set/Form and nonproductive math relevance, an other-world abstract cause with selected commitment intact, and a selected abstract capacity with accessible manifestation outside all three named productive branches. Rejected set-of-two anchor→all-sets-abstract, separation→no-esse, relevance→production and accessibility→selected actuality. No new source attribution or independent metaphysical warrant. Full exact boundaries in docs/notes/causal-concrete-rival-boundary.md.

Review correction: NamedCoverage is SelectedCounter→NamedCases, an implication between existential propositions, not a witness-preserving classification of every countertuple. Corrected the overclaim in its paraphrase and linked note; exact definitions, proof types, controls and conditional elimination are unchanged. A named case can coexist with unrelated capacity-only cases while that implication holds; the actual remainder requires absence of every named case in the selected profile. Universal per-tuple coverage would require a separate stronger proposition.
blocker: Independent warrant for the owner premise and the actual causal/existential-support interfaces remains OPEN. This intake does not derive EveryContingentGroundedAt or well-foundedness.
